title: Northstar beverage packaging checklist
scope: Fictional internal checklist for the Fieldday sample review. Not a regulatory standard.

requirements.title: Brand and product identity
requirements.rule: Brand and product identity must be visible on the front panel.

requirements.title: Ingredient declaration matches spec
requirements.phrase: Water, oats (12%), sunflower oil, sea salt.
requirements.rule: The artwork ingredient declaration must match the approved product specification.
requirements.expected: Water, oats (12%), sunflower oil, sea salt.
requirements.observed: Water, oats (12%), sunflower oil, sea salt.

requirements.title: Allergen statement matches spec
requirements.rule: The supplied allergen statement must be present on the pack.

requirements.title: Energy value present
requirements.rule: The sample nutrition panel must show its approved energy value.

requirements.title: Fat value present
requirements.rule: The sample nutrition panel must show its approved fat value.

requirements.title: Saturated fat value present
requirements.rule: The sample nutrition panel must show its approved saturated fat value.

requirements.title: Protein value present
requirements.rule: The sample nutrition panel must show its approved protein value.

requirements.title: Manufacturer and contact details present
requirements.rule: The sample artwork must show the manufacturer name and customer-care contact.

requirements.title: Recycling qualifier present
requirements.rule: The sample recycling message must retain its local-facilities qualifier.

requirements.title: Net quantity matches product spec
requirements.rule: The net quantity shown on the retail artwork must match the approved product specification, including the value and unit.

requirements.title: Storage statement appears on pack
requirements.rule: After-opening storage statement: ‘Refrigerate after opening.’ Include on each retail package.
